glyph.isekai_mahou.lg_mana_core.desc: AUGMENT (tribute to the magic-otaku seventh prince). The mana core in your chest ignites and OVERCHARGES the previous glyph: +30%% damage per copy (up to 3), paying 3%% of max mana per copy when cast. After the form, it applies to the whole spell. Arcane, arrives at level 18 (Circle 4) or from a scroll.
glyph.isekai_mahou.lg_chantless.desc: AUGMENT (the seventh prince). Who needs a chant? The spell fires INSTANTLY, with no chant and no announcement (Instant + Silent: costs +50%% and never enters the Stack). Arcane, arrives at level 18 (Circle 4) or from a scroll.
glyph.isekai_mahou.lg_grimoire.desc: Beneficial effect (Grim, the demon grimoire). Summons Grim for 20 s (Extend +) on the target's shoulder — you with Self, or an ally. It fires a mana bullet (5 damage) every 1.5 s at the nearest enemy, DEVOURS enemy projectiles and spell constructs near its owner (each refunds 3%% mana) and swallows one pending enemy cast every 3 s. Quiet in Peace Mode and in cities. Shadow, Master (Circle 4).
glyph.isekai_mahou.lg_pure_magic.desc: Effect (the seventh prince). Elementless pure mana: 10 damage × your MASTERY multiplier (grows with the sum of mastery levels of all your glyphs, up to ×2.5; half the bonus against players). With Self: half a second of gathering, then a straight 24-block beam (Expand +) piercing up to 8 enemies. Arcane, arrives at level 18 (Circle 4) or from a scroll.
glyph.isekai_mahou.lg_stone_cannon.desc: Effect (tribute to the Mushoku Tensei mage). A stone bullet forms, spinning, and fires blazing fast (Accelerate +): 16 Earth damage plus knockback; Pierce passes through (−30%% per target). On a target, the bullet forms 3 blocks away and drills into it (up to 3 bullets per cast); with Self it leaves your hand toward where you look. On a block it blasts a small hole (if terrain destruction is on and the place is not protected). Earth, Adept (Circle 3).
glyph.isekai_mahou.lg_quagmire.desc: Effect (Mushoku Tensei). The ground turns into mana mud in a 3.5 radius (Expand +) for 6 s (Extend +): enemies inside are heavily slowed, Soaked and cannot jump; bosses are only slightly slowed. Changes no blocks. With Self it appears where you look. Earth, Apprentice (Circle 2).
glyph.isekai_mahou.lg_demon_slayer_sword: Effect (tribute to the manaless boy with the black swords). An ANTI-MAGIC cut: 10 damage (×1.5 vs magical creatures), strips 2 buffs, interrupts and Silences for 2 s, COUNTERS the target's pending casts, devours loose enemy spells near it and SHATTERS the enemy domain it stands in (boss domains: −20%% barrier). With Self the slash flies 10 blocks in a line. In Black Form: ×1.3. Shadow, Adept (Circle 3).
glyph.isekai_mahou.lg_black_form.desc: Beneficial effect (Black Clover). 10 s (Extend +) of Black Asta on the target: +4 attack, more attack and move speed, +3 armor, MAGIC damage taken −40%% (−25%% from bosses), Silence and Corruption wear off and hits strip buffs. Afterwards the body feels heavy (Weakness 6 s). Shadow, Master (Circle 4).
glyph.isekai_mahou.lg_fairy_law.desc: Effect (tribute to the fairy guild). Golden light that judges only TRUE enemies — animals, villagers and allies caught in the area feel nothing: a pillar of light and 12 Light damage (×1.25 if you can see it; bosses ×0.7). With Self: judges every enemy you can see in an 8 radius (Expand +). With a big area form it becomes the real Fairy Law. Light, Master (Circle 4).
glyph.isekai_mahou.lg_serious_punch.desc: Effect (tribute to the bald hero). 10 damage + your Attack (up to 30; ×1.3 bare-handed) and a HUGE launch (bosses barely move). With Self: the punch becomes a 16-block cone wave (Expand +) and digs a short tunnel ahead (respects cities, towers and dungeons); if it is raining, it CLEARS THE SKY. Arcane, arrives at level 18 (Circle 4) or from a scroll.
glyph.isekai_mahou.lg_hinokami.desc: Effect (tribute to the Sun Breathing demon slayer, Hinokami Kagura). Three flame strikes on the target — Dance (6), Clear Blue Sky (4) and Solar Halo (6) — each with Burning 4 s; undead take ×1.5. With Self: a dash of up to 6 blocks (Accelerate +) cutting through the path, an arc ahead and a halo around. Never sets blocks on fire. Fire, Adept (Circle 3).
message.isekai_mahou.legends_g.anti_magi: Anti-magic: %s spells cut · %s buffs stripped · %s domains shattered
message.isekai_mahou.legends_g.black_for: Black Form for %s s: magic barely touches you.
Black Form fades... your body feels heavy.
